import zipfile, os, shutil
z=zipfile.ZipFile('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/pdf_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
out='/tmp/pdfseed'
shutil.rmtree(out, ignore_errors=True)
os.makedirs(out)
for n in ['pdf.js/test/pdfs/TrueType_without_cmap.pdf','pdf.js/test/pdfs/ContentStreamNoCycleType3insideType3.pdf','pdf.js/test/pdfs/Type3WordSpacing.pdf']:
    data=z.read(n)
    path=os.path.join(out, os.path.basename(n))

    print(path, len(data))
PY
./build.sh >/tmp/build.log 2>&1 || (tail -50 /tmp/build.log; exit 1)
